questions.q_en:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the son of B',

A − B means 'A is the wife of B',

A X B means 'A is the brother of B' and

A ÷ B means 'A is the daughter of B'.

Based on the above, how is P related to R if 'P X S ÷ M − T + R'?
questions.solution_en:
P X S ÷ M − T + R

P X S means 'P is the brother of S'

S ÷ M means 'S is the daughter of M'

M - T means 'M is the wife of T'

T + R means 'T is the son of R'

P is the son's son of R.

questions.q_en: If the 12th day of a month is four days earlier to Wednesday, then what day is the 25th of that month?
questions.solution_en:
12th day of a month is four days earlier to Wednesday, So 12th is Saturday

12+7= 19 is also Saturday

19+7= 26 is also Saturday

So, 25th is Friday.

So, 25th is Friday.

questions.q_en: Five actors are sitting at the corners of a pentagonal table. Only one actor is facing outside the centre of the table. J is immediate to the right of L. K is neighbour of X and Y. L is third to the left of X. The neighbours of Y are facing in the same direction. Who is facing outside the centre of the table?
questions.solution_en:
Five actors are sitting at the corners of a pentagonal table.

J is immediate to the right of L.

K is neighbour of X and Y.

L is third to the left of X.

The neighbours of Y are facing in the same direction.

Only one actor is facing outside the centre of the table.

Thus, case 1 is invalid.

So, X is facing outside the centre of the table.
